output.summary: Hartwell's AHT drop is partly real: Fast Path coaching and PolicyFind rolled out at all four sites, but the other sites' AHT stayed flat. The bonus also coincides with gaming. Transfers rose from 11% to 20%, agent releases rose 4.6x and cluster at minutes 6-7.5, and 7-day repeat contacts rose 41%. Tier-2 queue wait went from 2 to 9 minutes. Total effort per issue barely changed, so the $1.1M saving is unsupported. Survey eligibility excludes transferred and released calls, so flat CSAT is blind to these outcomes. The hailstorm does not explain the repeat-contact rise, which persists excluding claims-status calls. Attrition evidence is confounded by a new local outsourcer. Halt the rollout and redesign the incentive. Keep the release alert on.
